recipe.visualDefinition: A three-person group portrait featuring a central figure with arms outstretched behind two seated figures, set against a vibrant magenta-to-purple gradient background with high-contrast, textured typography framing the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Pyramidal composition with the central figure acting as the apex and the seated figures as the base.
Contrast between the warm red/magenta background and the cool blue/teal tones in the clothing and upper text.
Textural interplay between the smooth photographic skin tones and the heavy, patterned fills within the large-scale lettering.
coreInvariants: High-saturation magenta background with subtle grain.
Direct eye contact from at least one subject to engage the viewer.
90s-era streetwear including oversized jackets, patterns, and headwear.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects centered; one standing in the back-middle, two seated in the foreground left and right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white textured lettering at the bottom edge provides a heavy horizontal foundation.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top teal text, moves down to the central figure's face, follows the arms out to the seated figures, and rests on the large bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight framing with minimal negative space, primarily concentrated around the shoulders of the standing figure.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Teal/Deep Blue (Upper text and clothing shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with deep, crushed blacks in the shadows to create a 'moody' urban feel.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold, geometric sans-serif with tight kerning.
letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters.
Lowercase for the primary bottom display text.
Tight, touching, or overlapping letter spacing (kerning).
Use of clipping masks to apply textures (quilted or marble patterns) inside the glyphs.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'l' and 't' in the bottom text are extended to frame the composition.

composition.relationshipToImage: anchors the base of the subjects
floats above the central figure's head

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform font family with varying weights and texture fills to distinguish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Subtle outer glow on subjects to separate from background

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and specific lowercase 'e' and 'r' shapes.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Helvetica Black / Neue Haas Grotesk Black
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric foundation for the bold display.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of three men in 90s urban fashion. One man stands in the center with arms wide, wearing a colorful patterned shirt. Two men sit in front of him, one in a red hooded coat, the other in a red vest and black beret. Background is a vibrant magenta gradient with film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large lowercase text at the bottom in an ultra-bold sans-serif with a white quilted texture fill. Add a smaller line of text at the top in a teal marble-textured sans-serif. Ensure tight kerning so letters nearly touch.

verificationChecks: Is the background a saturated magenta?
Does the bottom text have a visible fabric/quilted texture?
Are the subjects arranged in a clear pyramid?
Is the typography ultra-bold and lowercase?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text texture does not obscure legibility.
Ensure the magenta background doesn't bleed into the skin tones excessively.
Verify the pyramidal composition is maintained.
Confirm the bottom text is the largest visual element.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-saturation gradient studio portrait with ultra-heavy, texture-masked sans-serif typography that frames the subjects at the top and bottom edges.
